module.title: Newtonian hydrodynamics: Riemann solvers, reconstruction, EOS, curvilinear coordinates, passive scalars
module.expensive_path: Per-cell reconstruction (PLM/PPM/fourth order) and Riemann solves (HLLE/HLLC/Roe/LLF) over every stage of the RK integrator; the 3-D linear-wave convergence series and general-EOS shock tubes spend essentially all time there.
module.rationale: The fluid core every other module builds on; one task because reconstruction, Riemann solver, EOS closure and coordinate geometry are exercised together by the same wave and shock tests.
excluded: MHD (field update and MHD Riemann solvers) -> athena-newtonian-mhd
SR/GR Riemann solvers and EOS -> relativity modules
hazards: eos_mhd needs MHD; survey may assign it to the MHD module
